themes.label: Crashes and slow loading on mobile
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android report the Notion mobile app freezing, crashing, or hanging on loading screens, often requiring a force close and reopen before they can type or open pages. Several note the app worked earlier and degraded after recent updates, and some say the desktop and web versions work fine by comparison. Reports on iPad and tablet-sized screens also describe unresponsive buttons and layouts running past the screen.
themes.recommendation: Pull crash and hang telemetry (symbolicated crash logs, main-thread stall traces, and page-load timings) segmented by app version from v1.7.2xx onward and by device, iPad and Android tablet included, then prioritise a fix for page-open and typing freezes before the next release.

themes.label: Mobile app usability and performance gaps
themes.summary: Many users praise Notion as an organizing tool on desktop and web but say the mobile app is slow, glitchy, and hard to navigate, with reports of wrong links being tapped, text selection jumping, and returning to the homepage when switching apps. Several Android reviewers say the quick-add widget stopped working and that the new AI-powered search makes it hard to open results, and some want mobile parity with desktop.
themes.recommendation: Triage Android mobile regressions from the last few app versions (v0.6.3836 to v0.6.4176), starting with the quick-add widget failure, link tap misrouting, and state loss when the app is backgrounded, and reproduce them on a mid-range device before the next release.

themes.label: Praise: all-in-one organization
themes.summary: Users in this cluster are overwhelmingly praising Notion as a flexible, all-in-one tool for organizing work, personal life, notes, and projects across devices, with many saying it is easy to use once learned. A minority mention friction: a steep subscription price, slowness and lag on Android, internet dependence, and missing features like multi-page selection.
themes.recommendation: Protect the cross-device sync and flexibility that drive this praise, and pull Android performance traces for lag, overheating, and AI-feature slowdowns on v0.6.37xx to v0.6.38xx, since these recur in the lower-rated reviews.

themes.label: Mobile text selection and copy-paste broken
themes.summary: Users on Android and iOS report that selecting, copying, or pasting text on the mobile app is unreliable: select-all only grabs a single block or paragraph, selections jump or snap back, and pasting sometimes fails or leaves blank space. Several reviewers say this is what keeps them from using Notion on phone as they do on desktop, and some mention the problem has persisted across multiple years and versions.
themes.recommendation: Create a bug epic for mobile selection and clipboard behavior, starting with reproducing select-all across nested blocks and paragraphs and large copy/paste on Android 0.6.x and iOS 1.7.x, then fix select-all to span the full page and verify with automated end-to-end tests.

themes.label: Mixed praise, scattered feature gaps
themes.summary: This cluster is mostly positive reviews praising Notion for note taking, organization, and templates, but the 3 star average reflects scattered complaints. The recurring negatives are a sluggish mobile app (slow loading, lag, and offline access gaps), missing handwriting, PDF markup and offline saving, and awkward text editing such as paragraph splitting, line spacing, and copy/select on Android. Many reviewers also feel the AI features and general scope are crowding out a focused notes experience.
themes.recommendation: Profile mobile cold-start and note-open times on low-end Android and iOS devices across recent versions, and prioritize the top causes, starting with the Android text selection and copy behavior that reviewers call a basic failure.

themes.label: Unexpected charges and refund denials
themes.summary: Users report being charged after cancelling, unauthorized or accidental renewals and add-ons, and support refusing refunds or going silent, with some saying card details stayed on file for other accounts. Several reviewers say they are cancelling or will not renew because of how billing and refunds are handled.
themes.recommendation: Audit recent billing and refund tickets for charges occurring after cancellation or from accidental seat additions, then define a refund exception path for accidental plan changes and confirm cancelled accounts stop being billed and have payment methods removed.

themes.label: Unwanted AI push and usage limits
themes.summary: Many users say they liked Notion before AI features were added and now feel pushed toward AI everywhere, with some wanting a way to fully disable it. Others say the AI quota is too restrictive, with free use running out quickly and requiring a subscription. A smaller group praises the AI features and simply wants a free tier with more usage.
themes.recommendation: Scope a settings toggle to hide or disable AI entry points (prompts, tabs, and the bottom-bar 'Ask AI' button) and evaluate a small free daily AI allowance (e.g., 5-10 uses) by checking conversion and churn impact through an A/B test.

themes.label: Praise: all-in-one organization
themes.summary: Users in this cluster are overwhelmingly praising Notion as a versatile all-in-one workspace for personal life, school, and work, with many saying it keeps them organized and lets them manage notes, tasks, trackers, and planning in one place. A recurring caveat is a learning curve, especially for templates and page setup, and a few reviewers note the phone app is harder to use than desktop or laptop.
themes.recommendation: Protect the all-in-one positioning by building an in-app onboarding path (starter templates and guided page setup) for new users, and run a usability review of the mobile editor to address the phone-versus-laptop experience gap reviewers mention.

reviews.t: Not enough customization; poor compatibility with Apple Accessibility features
reviews.x: At a first glance, Notion has everything in terms of customization - multiple colours, background colours, ability to embed videos and choose avatars for each of the projects. Unfortunately, a more important customization features are completely ignored - and that is the ability to choose font size. I want my to-do lists to be larger than a regular text, allowing me to check items on the go. There is just to option for that. And that’s disappointing. Moreover, changing the font size for the app in Accessibility settings of iPhone doesn’t translate well in the app itself - affecting only the text in some of the menus and headings of the pages. Not sure why, but I’m guessing something is off with the implementation on Notion’s side. In theory, all apps should react to these settings properly - at least that’s what Apple promised when they introduced the feature with iOS16. I will be willing to give Notion another try in the future and will gladly change the rating to 4 or 5 stars if the issue is fixed. Please update your information with this link. Also to note, you only get a reply every 24 hours, so after every (it’s so simple update your info) communication gets a bit tiresome. If you’ve seen Sh*+s creek this whole exchange was the equivalent of “just fold in the cheese - what do you mean - it’s easy, you just fold in the cheese”. I’ve tried to escalate this to a dept manager or someone in tech that would hopefully have the skills beyond “it’s so easy just update your information” however the more frustrated I get the less inclined they seem to be to help me. You can sync it across different apple devices and windows laptops and desktops which is huge. You can even share different lists and info with other users. My biggest issue is that I take notes for university and I find that the spell check is atrocious. At least on my devices. When I have a typo on my desktop, I have to right click on the word to select it, then left click to correct the word. Normal you might think? Except that I have to try several times to correct a single word because the left mouse click can take up to 4 times to register for some reason. I checked the same mouse with Microsoft Word and it had no issues. Another major problem is there doesn’t seem to be a dictionary, or a way to save a word so that it learns it and doesn’t think it’s a typo. On Microsoft Word for example, you can save phrase or a word that would be underlined in red so that it holds it in a dictionary and doesn’t indicated it to be wrong the next time you type it. I would love for motion to have this feature as I find it very useful. If you don’t want notion to show a bunch of red underlines for words that it doesn’t recognize (specifically if you’re in the medicine field or anything technical) then you’ll have to turn off spell check, which can bring different problems. Beyond those two issues I absolutely love this app and I hope the devs can work around this problem. Best of luck and many thanks to the people behind this great app.

I saw a thread on Twitter the other day about this same issue, and it was dated August 2019, so if I'm not wrong, they're delaying this fix since then. Notion devs, it's a pretty big deal to us. Please fix this soon! It's not usable on Android.

Powerful app & software! I've just started working with this software on my PC, decided to download the app so I could access my content from anywhere on my device. I understand the low rating, but it's a shame for such a powerful program. Yes, I must admit it, the app is a little slow and needs optimization to load the content more efficiently, especially if you have high quality images or lots of line in your pages, big blocks, etc. Devs will get there, give them time!

Great functionality for a note taking app, but initial load times on mobile make it hard for me to go all-in on. Love the functionality. Multiple workspaces, inline code editing. There are a few things it is still missing for me, like auto-clearing checked list items. But the biggest thing is the initial load on mobile. Sometimes I have a thought I need to get down quickly. Keep always loads in a second or two. I have to wait up to 4 or 5 sec with Notion. Unfortunate, cause I'd like to go all-in

Truly love Notion. It became my go-to after trying about 20 different note taking and organizing apps. I began using it less and less because it takes foooooooooorever to load up on mobile. I usually forget what notes i was planning on taking by the time it loads. It affects me enough that Im going to move to something else, but if it was fixed, I will return and give it another go. Thank you!

A surprisingly comprehensive app. I was looking for a Markdown to-do list/note-taking solution which works across platforms and devices, and bumped into it by accident. Since then I spent a day customising my homepage, adding tables, boards, interactivity, custom backgrounds, icons, tailored buttons to trigger actions... You name it. I hope this will be a long-standing relationship. Edit: turns out it wasn't. Too slow, too cumbersome - unfortunately, not for me.

I used to love Notion's desktop version, but the Android app unfortunately is inefficient. I was using it offline to take notes during a conference, and when I connected to the hotel's WI-FI, all my notes were completely gone. What happened? If the app is not usable offline, then please let the users know beforehand. You have the best note taking service out there and, please, listen to the customers feedback.

It draaaaaaaaags. Supposedly free upgrade for students, but there is no obvious link to upgrade. I came across an upgrade link, when trying to add an image to my first note page. I clicked it and waited and waited and waited and... finally gave up and wrote this review. It lagged significantly right from the start, setting up my account. Lags seem random when trying to use app, but are frequent. I first thought that it was me or a bad day for them, except that this is a complaint in every review

The app itself is terribly slow. It takes a while to load (on flagship Samsung phone!), because it makes a lot of network requests before letting you to do anything. Another design problem: offline mode. It will loose all your data if you close the app before going online. On the good side, It has pretty neat interface and very comfortable to use. Maybe worth checking in a year or so.

I love Notion! It is (was?) lightweight and a very customisable workspace which is great! I can take notes, write story draft, keep track on commissions and share my commission policy and information, keep a character database and what not! BUT, recently whenever I try to write for more than a moment, it will out of nowhere shut go out of writing mode, as if I had toggled it off myself. Sometimes it even shuts down. It's pretty frustrating as I use Notion on Android to work when on the go.

5 stars for the service itself, 2 stars for the app's loading times which are basically ridiculous. Every time I use the app, I have to force close it because it doesn't load the first time, but loads the second time after about 10 seconds (which is crazy). Otherwise, Notion is proving to be one of the most useful apps I've used in ages.

I've really enjoyed learning about your app, however recently I've found myself avoiding it and it's 90% because of two things: 1. Takes forever to load and if I'm flipping between apps it'll usually need to fully reload the whole application. So it's slow at every turn. I've been on speaker phone trying to look through notes and it's taking forever to load. 2. I've never had an app I use so frequently require so many logins. It's frequent. You spread that across 4 platforms and.... it's often.

On the whole I think this app is awesome, and allows me to quickly capture thoughts, tasks, reminders etc. My only gripe is that the android app occasionally kicks me out of the session and forces me to log in again, which involves waiting for an email to provide password. This is very frustrating if I'm in an area with no network. But on the whole....I love it!

Absolutely love Notion on desktop, but I'm considering moving to a different app due to the terrible mobile experience. Startup is much slower than competitors, taking well over 5 seconds, which is annoying and troublesome when I just want to jot down some notes or check my todo-list quickly. In addition, it crashes about 50% of the time which just makes it worse. If the development team just put a little bit more focus on the mobile side, Notion would definitely be my go-to!

I really like notion and find it really useful, so I don't want to give it up, but I run into major issues the Android app. Trying to select a favorite note to switch to right after opening the app sometimes causes a crash. Additionally, sometimes when reopening the app, the note I want will be open but then quickly replaced with a message that says this content doesn't exist, which is really frustrating when I know the note does still exist. I've had to switch back to other tools.

Great idea and UI, but needs speed improvement, and often crashes / logs me out (on mobile). Would want some quick add / widget functionality and halfway decent search before it would take me away from evernote. Not sure how real offline is, as I've tried accessing pages I've definitely looked at online, whilst offline and they don't load. Lots of potential; a lot of WIP.

Notion is an incredible service. One of the best. But this app for Android is not good. It's slow as a webapp, the features are confusing and hidden in menus, the app does not work offline, it takes more than 20 seconds to open, does not work well on slow and unstable connections, is not fluid and has no animations and a bug causes you to log in again every time the app is opened. I really hope for improvements.

Great website, terrible app. I recently started using the website notion.so for my all in one notes, todo list, reading list and more, and it's great. Unfortunately, this app is not. It's really slow to open (over 30s) which is a deal breaker for an app designed to take spur of the moment notes, and it keeps randomly logging me out, then once I log back in I have the same 30s loading wait

The app's nice and all, but I would quite like to be able to make text underlined, and to be able to select multiple lines of text - since you seem to enjoy the idea of moving things around so much. Other than that, an option to somehow export these documents, as markdown or otherwise, would be awesome. Thanks, and keep making notion awesome!

Amazing, well designed app (not only the Android version, desktop and web app as well). Some things do need improving though- The undo button is too hidden for something used so often and needed quickly. Launch time should be WAY shorter for a notes app, which is usually needed fast and on the go. Lastly, while I don't expect Notion to be free, the 1000 block cap doesn't truly allow the user to get a real feel of how powerful Notion can be.

Haven't even used it for a week and I absolutely love it. However, there's a couple things keeping me from a 5-star review. First, I'm left-handed, and that shouldn't make a difference, but I'm accidentally opening the side menu far too often, when I really just want to scroll sideways. Second, I want to see an option that lets you open links and bookmarks in your default browser, instead of a webview that I'm just going to reopen in my main browser anyway.
